# Portable feedback remains separate from world authority

Existing local issues cannot travel back from a friend and carry no images.
Add an explicitly consented portable report in the existing asset sheet, using
the established native preview capture and world-template handoff. Do not expand
local issue collection or build an online social system.

Rust owns immutable imported/local records in a dedicated table. Electron owns
only temporary review grants, picker handles, file serialization and capture.
This follows domain ownership and lets source-world identity survive attaching
a report to an independently created author world. Content hashes provide byte
integrity, not authenticity; imported statements remain untrusted data.

Review, export, import confirmation and AI draft preparation are separate player
actions. No report can silently write world source, become a tool instruction,
claim successful repair or auto-submit a model turn. A reply links a new report
to an existing ID, preserving history instead of rewriting a friend's words.
